understood: An admin-only CSV export of orders for the accountant, with fixed columns and format.

questions.question: Which orders go into one export: a date range the admin picks, the last month, or everything?
questions.why: It decides the UI and the size.

questions.question: Are cancelled and refunded orders included?
Are dates exported in Vietnam time (UTC+7), so an order at 23:30 Vietnam time counts on that day?
questions.why: Orders near midnight land on another day in UTC.

questions.question: For a large export, is a direct download acceptable, or should it be prepared in the background and offered when ready?
